messages:
maya: Heads up — last night during a staggered upgrade we saw cold prefixes rehydrate on different owners and duplicate apply logs for tenant acme. can we sanity check?

arun: got logs? my hunch: demote/rehydrate timing race causing ownership flip mid-apply.

maya: small excerpt: ```[2026-03-22T03:14:07Z] tenant=acme prefix=usr-23 apply=ok node=shard-7
[2026-03-22T03:14:07Z] tenant=acme prefix=usr-23 apply=ok node=shard-2
[2026-03-22T03:14:08Z] tenant=acme prefix=usr-23 commit=ok node=shard-2```

rick: yep. shard-7 started rehydrate then ownership moved to shard-2 before demote completed — double apply.

sasha: did demote observe backpressure? we have a soft-demote window but no strict fence.

arun: ops short-circuited drains; soft-demote issued but we skipped waiting for write-quiesce ack. reproducer is trivial.

maya: concern: duplicate applies could break non-idempotent ops (checkpoints, counters). we either need reapply-safety or remove the double-handback window.

rick: short-term: (1) gate model-layer applies with an op-id to make them idempotent; (2) add a demote fence that blocks transfer until rehydrate done. tradeoffs: #1 work across layers; #2 impacts roll time.

sasha: also recommend metrics: emit prefix_rehydrate_origin=(cold|handoff|failover) and rehydration_lag_ms so we can alert on drain-related spikes.

arun: runtime idea: mark prefixes rehydrated <X seconds after demote as suspicious and route reads via sequencer until ownership stabilizes. small perf hit but safer.

maya: ops note: drain cutoff is 30s now. bumping to 90s reduces races but increases upgrade time and adds risk during emergency rollbacks. tradeoff to discuss.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling-upgrade shard-7 -> shard-2 completed 03:20 UTC ✅

sasha: proposal: RFC "cold-prefix thaw handshake" — define demote fencing, reapply idempotency contract, metrics+alerts. who owns?

rick: i'll own the RFC and include a sim harness + regression test for duplicate-apply.

arun: i'll do metrics PR and add a small runtime gate for suspicious rehydrates.

maya: i'll file an incident note in postmortems and link RFC. tagging SRE for ops-window discussion.

sasha: immediate mitigation: ops flag to pause drain until demote ack count >= N OR rehydrate complete. small canary change.

maya: closing loop — follow-up RFC by EOD Friday.
